title: Consent
description: What a person allowed, for what purpose. Consent is an entity, not an assumption: no record, no transfer. A membership is not a consent, and an old consent for one purpose is not consent for a new one.

purpose.description: Recommendation, introduction and data transfer are three separate consents. Never collapse them.

scope.description: The specific fields covered. An empty scope covers nothing.

recipient_ref.description: Who the transfer is to, where the purpose names a recipient.

withdrawn_at.description: Present means withdrawn. A withdrawn consent is never revived by a later unrelated interaction.
